task_instance: Migrate a small, simple SDKv2 Terraform provider resource ("widget": flat schema with id/name(ForceNew)/description(optional)/enabled(bool, default true), no DiffSuppressFunc/CustomizeDiff/blocks) to the Plugin Framework, per SKILL.md: write the muxed main.go, translate the schema and CRUD skeleton following the null-vs-zero-value and id-retention rules, then verify per Step 5 that pre-existing acceptance tests still pass and that `terraform plan` against a pre-migration state file is empty.
blocker_detail: The skill's stated deliverable is a VERIFIED migration, not just translated code: SKILL.md Step 2 requires passing acceptance tests to exist before migration, and Step 5 requires (a) those same acceptance tests (go test, terraform-plugin-testing) pass unmodified against the migrated code, (b) a two-step ExternalProviders/ProtoV6ProviderFactories test proving an empty plan across the SDKv2->Framework boundary, and (c) `terraform plan` against a real pre-migration state file showing no diff. All three require compiling Go (go build/go vet), executing Go test binaries, and running the Terraform CLI against a compiled provider binary. This office-assistant runtime cannot run code, scripts, or commands of any kind and cannot produce/execute binaries, so the migration's schema/CRUD translation could be authored as text but could not be verified. A secondary, lesser issue: SKILL.md points to references/schema-mapping.md as the full SDKv2->Framework translation table, but only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist next to it in this environment, so only the mapping rules stated in the SKILL.md body itself were available to apply.
evidence: Wrote sdkv2_resource_widget.go (sample input SDKv2 resource with flat schema, ForceNew name, optional description, bool enabled with Default:true - matching the skill's 'simple resources migrate safely' criteria). Wrote framework_resource_widget.go (hand-translated Plugin Framework resource: schema.StringAttribute/BoolAttribute mirroring each SDKv2 field, ForceNew -> stringplanmodifier.RequiresReplace(), Default:true -> booldefault.StaticBool(true), id attribute kept per the 'migrated resource must keep its exact schema' rule, and an explicit comment/TODO for the null-vs-'' translation the skill calls out as the main behavioral trap). Wrote main_mux.go (muxed provider entrypoint adapted from the skill's Step 1 example). Wrote verification_notes.md documenting exactly which Step 5 verification actions require code/CLI execution (go build, go test for TestAcc*_basic/_disappears/ImportStateVerify, terraform init/plan with ExternalProviders and a real state file) and were therefore not attempted or faked. No shell/Bash tool was used; no code was executed; no binaries were produced. Could not confirm the translated Go even compiles, so the deliverable exists as text only and is unverified, matching the 'not_achieved' / missing_tool_in_runtime criteria in the task instructions.
